The '''Multimedia and Special Projects Advocate''' was an advocate seat created in June 2018, when the [[Players Committee]] took over [[GEMP]]. Its holder led a team to run GEMP and oversaw multimedia and website projects.<ref name="gemp2018">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/gemp-announcements-request-for-applications-for-new-team/ GEMP Announcements &amp; Request for Applications for New Team], starwarsccg.org (7 June 2018)</ref>
